parameters.jsCode: const p=$json.body??$json; const required=['invoice_number','supplier_id','total','currency']; const missing=required.filter(k=>p[k]===undefined||p[k]===null||p[k]===''); if(missing.length) throw new Error(`MISSING_CRITICAL_FIELD: ${missing.join(',')}`); if(p.extracted_total!==undefined && Number(p.extracted_total)!==Number(p.total)) throw new Error(`DATA_CONFLICT: extracted_total=${p.extracted_total}, submitted_total=${p.total}`); if(p.simulate==='timeout') throw new Error('API_TIMEOUT: accounting platform did not respond'); return [{json:{invoice_number:p.invoice_number,supplier_id:p.supplier_id,total:Number(p.total),currency:p.currency,status:'validated'}}];
